meta.description: Interventional cardiologist practising at Geitaoui and Karantina hospitals in Beirut. Consultations, cardiac testing, coronary angiography and angioplasty.

hero.heading: Cardiology care in Beirut, from consultation to intervention
hero.subheading: Dr Jean Obeid sees patients at Geitaoui and Karantina hospitals. If you are worried about your heart, or a parent's, you can reach the clinic directly.
